title: A systematic and comprehensive analysis of colorectal squamous cell carcinoma: Implication for diagnosis and treatment.
authors: Yang, Yang; Yu, Jiarui; Hu, Jitao; Zhou, Chaoxi; Niu, Jian; Ma, Hongqing; Han, Jiaxu; Fan, Shaoqing; Liu, Youqiang; Zhao, Yalei; Zhao, Lianmei; Wang, Guiying
one_liner_zh: 该文基于SEER数据库和转录组数据构建结直肠鳞癌预后列线图并探索分子机制，虽涉及转录因子TP63/STAT1分析及分子对接，但核心是临床预后与肿瘤机制，非蛋白质-DNA互作建模研究，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: This study was aimed at establishing a nomogram for survival prediction of Colorectal squamous cell carcinoma (CSCC), understanding the molecular pathogenesis, exploring a better treatment, and predicting the potential therapeutic agents. METHODS: Surveillance, Epidemiology, and End Results (SEER) database was used to obtained CSCC patients and the nomogram was performed. Propensity score matching (PSM), Kaplan-Meier analysis, subgroup analysis, and interaction test were used to explore the better treatment strategy for CSCC. Bioinformatics were used to explore the molecular mechanism and potential therapeutic drugs of CSCC. RESULTS: A total of 3949 CSCC patients were studied. The nomogram was constructed and evaluated to have a good performance. We found that the radiotherapy had a better effect than surgery, and the difference between radiotherapy and combined therapy was not significant. 821 differentially expressed genes in CSCC were obtained from GSE6988 dataset. DNA damage repair, mismatch repair, and cell cycle pathways might contribute to CSCC occurrence as indicated by KEGGpathway and GSEA analysis. Transcription factors analysis revealed that TP63 and STAT1 may have an important role in occurrence and development of CSCC. 1607 potential drugs against CSCC were found using the CMAP database, and molecular docking was carried out to show the binding energy between TP63 and drugs. CONCLUSIONS: A good prognosis nomogram was constructed for CSCC. We also have a better understanding of the underlying molecular mechanisms of occurrence and development of CSCC and predicted potential therapeutic drugs, providing a theoretical basis for the treatment of CSCC.
abstract_zh: 背景：本研究旨在建立结直肠鳞状细胞癌（CSCC）生存预测的列线图，了解其分子发病机制，探索更优的治疗方案，并预测潜在的治疗药物。方法：使用监测、流行病学和最终结果（SEER）数据库获取CSCC患者数据，并构建列线图。采用倾向评分匹配（PSM）、Kaplan-Meier分析、亚组分析和交互作用检验来探索CSCC的更优治疗策略。利用生物信息学方法探讨CSCC的分子机制和潜在治疗药物。结果：共研究了3949例CSCC患者。构建的列线图经评估具有良好的性能。我们发现放疗效果优于手术，而放疗与联合治疗之间的差异不显著。从GSE6988数据集中获得了821个CSCC差异表达基因。KEGG通路和GSEA分析表明，DNA损伤修复、错配修复和细胞周期通路可能促进CSCC的发生。转录因子分析显示，TP63和STAT1可能在CSCC的发生和发展中发挥重要作用。通过CMAP数据库发现了1607种针对CSCC的潜在药物，并进行了分子对接以显示TP63与药物之间的结合能。结论：我们为CSCC构建了一个预后良好的列线图。同时，我们对CSCC发生和发展的潜在分子机制有了更深入的了解，并预测了潜在的治疗药物，为CSCC的治疗提供了理论基础。
